description: Capability for the main window. Only what the frontend calls: event listen/unlisten (listen() in +layout.svelte and tray.ts), window hide (Ctrl+H minimise to tray in +page.svelte) and the notification calls behind isPermissionGranted, requestPermission and sendNotification (notifications.ts). Tray, dialogs and window show/close run from Rust and need no permission here.
